name: WPAuto
author: plugin.net

sections.description:
WP Auto enables effortless scraping of websites, blog posts, RSS Feeds, WooCommerce sites, and Amazon listings with its user-friendly setup. Beyond scraping, WP Auto leverages OpenAI to generate articles with featured images.

It offers built-in spinners and OpenAI functionality for content rewriting, ensuring uniqueness and aiding in Google ranking. Save valuable time and eliminate manual work hassle with the automatic scraping technique. Ideal for users of all skill levels, from novices to experts.

Key Features

  1. User-friendly interface for easy campaign setup.
  2. Unlimited campaign creation options.
  3. Easy selection of titles, content, and images using the visual selection method.
  4. Built-in CRON function for automatic operations.
  5. Google Translator support for translating articles into your desired language.
  6. Supported spinner functionality for article rewriting and improved ranking.
  7. Dalle feature for generating featured images to resolve copyright issues.
  8. Option to set new scraped posts to the original time of the source article.
  9. Storage of scraped articles in desired post types: Post, Page, or Custom Post.
  10. Hyperlink management: add or remove hyperlinks in articles.

Third-Party Services

WPAuto uses the following third-party services to increase the ability of the plugin :

  1. Pixels
  2. Pixabay
  3. OpenAI GPT
  4. WordAI
  5. Spin Rewriter
  6. Google Query
  7. [Google Translate]https://translate.googleapis.com

sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Upload ‘wpauto’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Do I need to have coding skills to use the Plugin?

No, you don’t need any coding skills.

Does the plugin work with any WordPress themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any themes that have been coded following WordPress guidelines.
